\begin{theorem}[Cylinder curl factorization and branch dictionary]
On transverse tensors and vectors on the unit three-sphere,
$\mathcal C_2^2=-D^2+3$ and $\mathcal C_1^2=-D^2+2$.
The Lorentzian reduced operators factor as
\[B_{\rm TT}=[\partial_t^2+(\mathcal C_2-1)^2]
[\partial_t^2+(\mathcal C_2+1)^2],\qquad
P_A=\partial_t^2+\mathcal C_1^2.\]
The lower TT, non-Killing transverse-vector, and upper TT branches
are exactly the parity-complete $E$, $A$, and $L$ towers at every
energy, including the low-energy exceptions $N_E\ge2$, $N_A\ge3$
and $N_L\ge4$.
\end{theorem}
